witness.branch: Motor bus in a school zone with children
witness.quote: A person shall not drive a motor vehicle at a speed in excess of 15 miles per hour
witness.reason: A motor bus can travel within the fixed school zone containing children; children alone do not establish the restriction's temporal applicability.
required_context: Establish designated school-zone boundaries, school-property adjacency, a supported bus route and children's locations.
Establish driver attribution, qualifying motor-vehicle status, supported bus route, school-property adjacency, zone designation and children's locations.
Establish operational-beacon designation and behavior or the exact sign-time branch facts.
Establish operational-beacon designation, configuration and behavior or the exact nonoperational-beacon sign-time branch.
Identify the bus driver and establish qualifying motor-vehicle status.
Preserve all four exceptions and the exact 15 miles per hour obligation; neither children nor beacon flashing alone establishes that no exception applies.
Supply independent date, local time, session calendar, operation end and next-start times, and class hours.
Supply school calendar, operation times, class hours, civil date and local time independently of children and indications, supporting an interval outside the exceptions.
witness.subject_reason: The available bus_driver is a person driving a motor vehicle if the constructed bus meets that definition.
